depth_check.caveat: state blocked durations may overlap; not NPU stall

demand.comparison: strict underload requires D_s < capacity; >= intervals include equality
demand.definition: sum current admitted request actual per-SSU layer GiB / pure layer seconds; no double-counted next-request L0

measurement_definition.cohorts: window admissions, followed to completion; full population when full=true
measurement_definition.latency: completion minus admission or original arrival; no first-token event simulated

io_stall.definition: Exposed NPU wait only; intersect [compute_start - io_barrier_wait, compute_start) with window
